_doc: Per-map overrides of single converted shaders (h2conv/shader_overrides.py, applied by handlers/shaders.py after the arrays are final).
map: the input map's scenario tag path (lower case); only that map is touched, every other map converts byte-identically.
shader: the shader tag path (lower case).  ops: scale_pc = multiply the first 4 bytes of the listed Pixel Constants by factor (floor, per byte).
chronopolis couch (2026-10-28): the two tinted shaders of couch_chrono render washed out in Vista (flat gold frame, grey cushions) - the pass
lightmap_tex_detail_blend (dynamic object implementations) computes sat(2*base*mix)*diffuse_color + diffuse_color_offset and then 2*lighting with
saturation, so the bright albedo saturates; halving PC[0] (diffuse_color) and PC[1] (diffuse_color_offset) gave the orange-red frame and dark
cushions of MCC in game.  This is a per-map override, not a general rule.
